# Synthica

> Synthica is a free, non-selective research community that gives high school students a playground to conduct original research and participate in international competitions, regardless of their background, experience, or resources.

Synthica helps high school students start and grow a research career with a zero-cost, non-selective program. Members join a global network of student researchers, learn the foundations of academic research from an expert curriculum, build their own original research projects, and showcase their findings at international research competitions.

## Key facts

- **Audience:** high school students worldwide
- **Cost:** free / zero cost
- **Selectivity:** non-selective — open to all high school students
- **Community:** 1600+ researchers as members across the world
- **Outcomes:** original student research projects and international research competition participation

## How it works (4 steps)

1. Join the global student research community (Discord).
2. Learn research foundations from the expert curriculum at your own pace.
3. Develop your own original research project with community guidance.
4. Participate in international research competitions and showcase your work.

## Core values

- Accessibility — every high school student deserves the opportunity to explore academic research.
- Excellence — a curriculum reviewed by top university researchers.
- Community — a global, peer-driven network of student researchers.
- Innovation — original student research and competition opportunities.
